utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, right, the carpool. I heard there was a schedule change, so I’m checking on it while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll check with you when I’m back so we’ve got the right schedule.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — just let me know when you’ve checked it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what time are we leaving?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll pick you up at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, see you at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the carpool is still on for tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still on. I’m just hoping everyone’s ready on time so we don’t get held up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to make sure. I’ll plan on being there tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the carpool. I think I can make it work, but I may need a reminder on the time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll text you the time in a minute, just so you don’t miss it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, thanks — I’ll watch for your text.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, I’ll check the details first. What time are you planning to leave?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Probably around 8:00, but I should double-check the time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries, just let me know once you’ve confirmed the time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late - what did I miss about the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — we were just sorting the pickup order and times. I can fill you in and we’ll get you added.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great — fill me in and I’ll take whatever pickup slot works.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the carpool. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can drive, if you can handle the pickups and drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, I can handle that. I’ll take care of the pickups and drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can take the earlier pickup and head to the east lot if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me, thanks. I’ll meet you at the east lot for the earlier pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll see you at the east lot then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Quinn, I heard the carpool might need one extra seat this week, so I’m checking who can take it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I can take it if that helps, and I’ll ask around for one more backup just in case.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, that helps a lot. I’ll let the others know you can cover it, and we’ve got a backup in progress.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time is the carpool tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Around 8 a.m. works for me.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll be there at 8 a.m. then.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can do the school run.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks. I’ll do the pickup part then.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, I’ll handle the school run.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, I’ve got the carpool list ready. Just let me know your schedule and I’ll slot you in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, I can do mornings or after 5. Put me wherever it fits best.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll put you in one of those spots and send you the final pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the school changed the carpool lineup again. I can fill you in if you need the latest.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please fill me in. I like to keep the plan straight.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure — I heard they moved one family to the earlier slot and shifted the rest down by ten minutes, so it should be a little smoother now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I can probably make it if you leave a seat open for me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll leave a seat open for you.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, I’ll meet you there then.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, I appreciate it. I just need to sort out a few things on my end first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No rush, just let me know when you’ve got everything sorted.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can do carpool tomorrow if you still need a seat.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes please, if you can still take one more seat.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yes, happy to. I’ll take the extra seat tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can ask around and see if anyone can take a turn with the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, please let me know who can take which day before you confirm anything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — I’ll check who can do which day and only confirm once I’ve got the schedule from everyone.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the carpool. I might've missed the latest update; what's changed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: The pickup moved to 8:15, and Lena’s taking the first shift this week. I can send you the latest list after this.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, 8:15 and Lena’s on first shift. Send me the list when you can so I don’t miss anything else.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I can take the Tuesday pickup if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, that covers Tuesday. I’ll take the other pickup if needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, then I’ve got Tuesday covered.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can handle the carpool this week if you need me to.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, I’ll take the next one.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, just let me know when you want me to cover it again.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Can we confirm the pickup times? I want to make sure the carpool doesn’t get tangled up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, let's keep it simple: 8:00 and 8:15 work for me. I’ll stick to those.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, that sounds simpler. I’ll plan around those two times.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I can ask around and get a carpool going.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks. I’ll check in about rides too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll ask a couple more neighbors and see who can join in. We should have a solid carpool soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can take the early drop-off if that helps with the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d help a lot, thanks. I can handle the later pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll handle the early drop-off, then. Thanks for covering pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the carpool schedule drafted, Nell. I’ll send you the pickup times and drivers after I confirm the last two slots.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa. Just send me whatever you have once the last two slots are set.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll send it over as soon as I lock those last two slots.
